SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m,
       count(*) AS n_lines,
       count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS n_distinct_lines,
       count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS n_ids,
       sum(f.gross_amount) AS gross,
       sum(f.net_amount) AS net,
       sum(round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2)) AS recomputed_gross,
       sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inconsistent_lines,
       min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate,
       CASE WHEN f.sale_date < DATE '2024-09-01' THEN 'pre' ELSE 'post' END AS vs_change,
       count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.net_amount) net,
       sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS date_mismatch
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2,3

WITH c AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', business_date) m, sum(net_sales_before_returns) ctrl_net_before_returns, sum(returns_net) ret, sum(net_sales) ns
  FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id < 900
  GROUP BY 1),
f AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, sum(f.net_amount) net
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT c.m, c.ctrl_net_before_returns, f.net, f.net - c.ctrl_net_before_returns AS gap, c.ret, c.ns
FROM c JOIN f USING (m) ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS m,
       CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN '999 training' WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN '900 web'
            WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 'physical ZZ Test' ELSE 'physical' END AS grp,
       count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) staff_gross,
       min(f.gross_amount) min_gross, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 OR f.gross_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH fin AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) AS month_start, f.sale_date
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test')
SELECT month_start, count(DISTINCT sale_date) days_with_sales,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_date d WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND date_trunc('month', d.calendar_date)=fin.month_start AND d.is_trading_day) AS trading_days
FROM fin GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', f.sale_date), '%Y-%m') AS calendar_month,
       SUM(f.gross_amount) AS store_sales_incl_vat_before_returns
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id < 900 AND s.store_id <> 999
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
